name: text-state-swap
description: A text state swap primitive with outgoing blur and incoming lift

vars.description: The outgoing label, on screen before the swap.
The incoming label, on screen after the swap. It rests hidden until the timeline reveals it.
Scales the vertical offset the timeline drives, so each label covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.
Label colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
